evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from ~28,800 to 16.5 ppm, and it stayed around 4–8 ppm afterwards
Thermocouple followed the ramp setpoint to within 1 °C
Brief 10 °C overshoot at the start of growth, then held at 750 ± 0.3 °C
Heater power steady at about 45–46% during the hold, consistent with the temperature
Ar at 100 ± 1 sccm and pressure steady at about 761.5 Torr, so no sign of a leak or blockage

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet. The growth-stage telemetry did not include ref values, so the readings could only be checked against setpoints and physical consistency.
